dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 23, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Astros Outlast Blue Jays in Toronto**

The Houston Astros notched a 9-7 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Joey Loperfido leading the charge. Loperfido homered and drove in four runs, while Peter Lambert impressed on the mound, striking out six in 4.2 innings of work. Logan VanWey earned the win.

**Mariners Edge Pirates in Pittsburgh**

The Seattle Mariners took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2, with Cole Young delivering the go-ahead hit. Young homered and drove in two runs, while George Kirby tossed six strong innings, allowing just one earned run. Andrés Muñoz notched the save.

**Royals Rout Rays in Tampa Bay**

The Kansas City Royals dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 12-5, with Jac Caglianone putting up three hits and two home runs. Luinder Avila pitched five solid innings, striking out six, and earning the win.

**Marlins Outlast Rangers in Miami**

The Miami Marlins edged the Texas Rangers 4-6, with Owen Caissie homering and driving in three runs. Sandy Alcantara pitched six innings, allowing just one earned run, and earned the win.

**Yankees Top Tigers in Detroit**

The New York Yankees took down the Detroit Tigers 4-3, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. homering and driving in two runs. Kyle Finnegan pitched 1.1 scoreless innings to earn the win.

**Phillies Rout Nationals in Washington**

The Philadelphia Phillies crushed the Washington Nationals 14-9, with Edmundo Sosa homering and driving in five runs. Jesús Luzardo struck out 13 in 6.2 innings, but took the loss.

**Cubs Outlast Mets in New York**

The Chicago Cubs edged the New York Mets 9-6, with Dansby Swanson homering and driving in four runs. Edward Cabrera earned the win.

**Brewers Shut Out Reds in Cincinnati**

The Milwaukee Brewers blanked the Cincinnati Reds 2-0, with Brandon Sproat tossing six shutout innings and striking out 10.

**Dodgers Rout Twins in Minnesota**

The Los Angeles Dodgers dominated the Minnesota Twins 12-3, with Brooks Lee homering and driving in one run. Justin Wrobleski earned the win.

**White Sox Edge Guardians in Cleveland**

The Chicago White Sox took down the Cleveland Guardians 2-1, with Miguel Vargas homering and driving in one run. Sean Burke earned the win.

**Diamondbacks Edge Cardinals in St. Louis**

The Arizona Diamondbacks edged the St. Louis Cardinals 4-3, with Lourdes Gurriel Jr. driving in two runs. Kevin Ginkel earned the win.

**Red Sox Top Rockies in Colorado**

The Boston Red Sox took down the Colorado Rockies 5-2, with Wilyer Abreu homering and driving in two runs. Sonny Gray pitched seven strong innings, striking out 11, and earned the win.

**Angels Rout Orioles in Los Angeles**

The Los Angeles Angels dominated the Baltimore Orioles 5-1, with Nolan Schanuel homering and driving in two runs. Ryan Johnson pitched six shutout innings and earned the win.

**Padres Edge Braves in San Diego**

The San Diego Padres took down the Atlanta Braves 7-6, with Fernando Tatis Jr. homering and driving in two runs. Mason Miller earned the win.

**Giants Edge Athletics in San Francisco**

The San Francisco Giants took down the Oakland Athletics 3-1, with Jung Hoo Lee homering and driving in one run. Robbie Ray pitched eight strong innings, striking out six, and earned the win.
